words.definition: An act of travelling from one place to another.
words.example_en: The journey to the mountains took three hours.
words.example_sk: Cesta do hôr trvala tri hodiny.

words.definition: To travel through or investigate a place or subject in order to learn more about it.
words.example_en: We want to explore the old castle this weekend.
words.example_sk: Tento víkend chceme preskúmať starý hrad.

words.definition: Having beautiful natural scenery; visually attractive, especially in the countryside.
words.example_en: We took the scenic route through the mountains.
words.example_sk: Išli sme malebnou trasou cez hory.

words.definition: The act of coming to a place or reaching a destination.
words.example_en: We were excited about her arrival at the airport.
words.example_sk: Tešili sme sa na jej príchod na letisko.

words.definition: The act of leaving a place, especially to start a journey.
words.example_en: The departure of the train is scheduled for 8:15.
words.example_sk: Odchod vlaku je naplánovaný na 8:15.

words.definition: A book that gives information or advice about a place, subject, or activity.
words.example_en: We bought a guidebook before traveling to Italy.
words.example_sk: Pred cestou do Talianska sme si kúpili sprievodcu.

words.definition: In a way that avoids harm, danger, or risk.
words.example_en: Please drive safely on the icy road.
words.example_sk: Prosím, jazdite bezpečne na zľadovatenej ceste.

words.definition: The place where someone or something is going.
words.example_en: Paris is our final destination.
words.example_sk: Paríž je náš konečný cieľ.

words.definition: The activity of visiting interesting places, especially as a tourist.
words.example_en: We went sightseeing in Prague during the weekend.
words.example_sk: Počas víkendu sme boli na prehliadke pamiatok v Prahe.

words.definition: A way or course taken to get from one place to another.
words.example_en: We took a different route to avoid the traffic.
words.example_sk: Išli sme inou trasou, aby sme sa vyhli premávke.

words.definition: Belonging to or connected with a particular area, place, or neighborhood.
words.example_en: We bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.example_sk: Kúpili sme čerstvú zeleninu na miestnom trhu.

words.definition: Kind, pleasant, and acting like a friend.
words.example_en: She is very friendly to everyone at work.
words.example_sk: Je veľmi priateľská ku každému v práci.

words.definition: To put things into a container for carrying, storing, or sending; or a small wrapped collection of items.
words.example_en: Please pack your clothes before the trip.
words.example_sk: Prosím, zabaľ si oblečenie pred cestou.

words.definition: Arriving, happening, or being done at the expected or scheduled time.
words.example_en: The train arrived on time.
words.example_sk: Vlak prišiel načas.

words.definition: Immediately, without any delay.
words.example_en: Please call me right away if you hear any news.
words.example_sk: Prosím, zavolaj mi ihneď, ak sa dozvieš nejaké novinky.

words.definition: A period of time when someone takes a break from work, school, or daily activities to rest or travel.
words.example_en: We are going on vacation next week.
words.example_sk: Budúci týždeň ideme na dovolenku.

words.definition: Bags, suitcases, and other items that you carry when traveling.
words.example_en: Please keep your luggage with you at all times.
words.example_sk: Prosím, majte svoju batožinu stále pri sebe.

words.definition: Providing physical ease or relaxation; pleasant to wear, sit on, or use.
words.example_en: These shoes are very comfortable.
words.example_sk: Tieto topánky sú veľmi pohodlné.

words.definition: Not far away; close to a particular place.
words.example_en: There is a pharmacy nearby.
words.example_sk: Neďaleko je lekáreň.

words.definition: To register your arrival, especially at a hotel, airport, or for a flight.
words.example_en: We need to check in at the hotel before 3 p.m.
words.example_sk: Musíme sa prihlásiť v hoteli pred 15:00.

words.translation: obísť; pohybovať sa; dostať sa okolo; rozšíriť sa
words.definition: To move from place to place, to avoid or bypass something, or for information to spread among people.
words.example_en: She gets around the city by bike because parking is expensive.
words.example_sk: Po meste sa pohybuje na bicykli, pretože parkovanie je drahé.

words.definition: To make something clear or easy to understand by giving more information or details.
words.example_en: Can you explain this word to me?
words.example_sk: Môžeš mi vysvetliť toto slovo?

words.definition: To say or write what someone or something is like.
words.example_en: Can you describe your new house?
words.example_sk: Vieš opísať svoj nový dom?

words.definition: To suggest that someone or something would be good or suitable for a particular purpose.
words.example_en: I recommend this book to anyone who wants to learn English.
words.example_sk: Odporúčam túto knihu každému, kto sa chce naučiť po anglicky.

words.definition: Showing good manners and respect for other people.
words.example_en: It is polite to say thank you.
words.example_sk: Je zdvorilé povedať ďakujem.

words.definition: In a way that is easy to see, hear, understand, or recognize; without doubt.
words.example_en: She spoke clearly so that everyone could understand her.
words.example_sk: Hovorila jasne, aby jej každý rozumel.

words.definition: If you do something in person, you are physically present rather than communicating by phone, email, or another method.
words.example_en: We met in person for the first time yesterday.
words.example_sk: Včera sme sa prvýkrát stretli osobne.

words.definition: To continue communicating with someone.
words.example_en: Let's keep in touch after you move to another city.
words.example_sk: Zostaňme v kontakte aj po tom, čo sa presťahuješ do iného mesta.

words.definition: To talk about something with another person or a group, often to exchange ideas or decide something.
words.example_en: We need to discuss the plan before making a decision.
words.example_sk: Pred prijatím rozhodnutia musíme prediskutovať plán.

words.definition: To speak or write about something briefly or by name.
words.example_en: She didn't mention the meeting yesterday.
words.example_sk: Včera nespomenula stretnutie.

words.definition: To say, do, or happen again.
words.example_en: Could you repeat the question, please?
words.example_sk: Mohli by ste zopakovať otázku, prosím?

words.definition: To state or show that something is true, correct, or certain.
words.example_en: Please confirm your email address before registering.
words.example_sk: Pred registráciou si prosím potvrď svoju e-mailovú adresu.

words.definition: Giving attention to detail and avoiding mistakes or danger.
words.example_en: Be careful when you cross the street.
words.example_sk: Buď opatrný, keď prechádzaš cez ulicu.

words.definition: Willing or able to help; useful.
words.example_en: She gave me some helpful advice.
words.example_sk: Dala mi niekoľko nápomocných rád.

words.definition: Using the telephone as a way of communicating.
words.example_en: We discussed the details by phone.
words.example_sk: Podrobnosti sme prediskutovali telefonicky.

words.definition: Able to stay calm and not get angry, especially when something takes a long time; also, a person who is receiving medical treatment.
words.example_en: You need to be patient while learning a new skill.
words.example_sk: Pri učení sa novej zručnosti musíš byť trpezlivý.

words.definition: Going in a straight line or by the shortest way; to aim, control, or manage something.
words.example_en: She gave me direct instructions about how to complete the form.
words.example_sk: Dala mi presné pokyny, ako vyplniť formulár.

words.definition: Following established rules, customs, or conventions; suitable for official or serious situations.
words.example_en: He wore formal clothes to the business meeting.
words.example_sk: Na obchodné stretnutie mal oblečené formálne oblečenie.

words.definition: Relaxed and friendly in style or manner; not official or formal.
words.example_en: The meeting was informal, so everyone felt comfortable speaking freely.
words.example_sk: Stretnutie bolo neformálne, takže sa každý cítil pohodlne a mohol hovoriť slobodne.

words.definition: To speak more loudly so that people can hear you, or to express your opinion openly.
words.example_en: Please speak up if you want everyone to hear your idea.
words.example_sk: Prosím, hovor hlasnejšie, ak chceš, aby všetci počuli tvoj nápad.

words.definition: To request or seek something from someone.
words.example_en: She asked for a glass of water.
words.example_sk: Požiadala o pohár vody.

words.definition: To discuss, mention, or say something about a particular subject.
words.example_en: We need to talk about the problem.
words.example_sk: Musíme hovoriť o tom probléme.

words.definition: To write something on paper or in a document so that you can remember or use it later.
words.example_en: Please write down your phone number.
words.example_sk: Prosím, zapíš si svoje telefónne číslo.

words.definition: To return a phone call, or an act of calling someone again later.
words.example_en: I was in a meeting, so I will call back later.
words.example_sk: Bol som na porade, takže zavolám späť neskôr.

words.definition: To discover or learn information.
words.example_en: I need to find out what time the meeting starts.
words.example_sk: Potrebujem zistiť, o koľkej sa začína stretnutie.

words.definition: To look at something carefully, to investigate it, or to leave a hotel after paying.
words.example_en: You should check out this new restaurant.
words.example_sk: Mal by si si pozrieť túto novú reštauráciu.

words.definition: To inform someone or tell them something.
words.example_en: Please let me know if you need any help.
words.example_sk: Prosím, daj mi vedieť, ak budeš potrebovať pomoc.

words.definition: To review, examine, or discuss something carefully; also to cross from one place to another.
words.example_en: Let's go over the main points before the meeting.
words.example_sk: Poďme si pred stretnutím prejsť hlavné body.

words.definition: To continue or to happen.
words.example_en: Please go on with your story.
words.example_sk: Prosím, pokračuj vo svojom príbehu.

words.definition: To receive news, a message, or communication from someone.
words.example_en: I was happy to hear from my old friend after so many years.
words.example_sk: Potešilo ma, keď som po toľkých rokoch dostal správu od svojho starého priateľa.
